stories.title: Bitcoin holds near $78,000 after best week in three years for altcoins
stories.summary: Bitcoin is trading near $78,000 while gold also rallies. Altcoins are consolidating after their best week in three years. A weekend price dip liquidated about $250 million in over-leveraged long positions, and open interest has weakened.
stories.whyItMatters: A leverage flush-out and softer open interest can signal cooling speculation even during a strong rally.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin holds support near $78,000
Open interest trend over the coming week
Whether altcoins extend last week's gains
questions: Is the rally driven by spot demand or by leverage?
Will bitcoin and gold keep moving together?

stories.title: Bitcoin posts second-best week since early 2021 as crypto market rebounds
stories.summary: Bitcoin just had its second-best week since early 2021, lifting the broader crypto market. Separately, crypto card spending has topped $1 billion as stablecoins move into everyday purchases. CoinDesk also reports that stablecoins are increasingly used to pay AI agents.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising stablecoin use in card payments and agent-to-agent commerce is a concrete adoption signal beyond price speculation.
whatToWatch: Growth in stablecoin card spending volume
Further stablecoin payment integrations for AI agents
questions: How much of the card spending growth is new usage versus shifted from other payment rails?
Which stablecoins are AI agents actually using?

stories.title: Bitget CEO stays cautious on bitcoin rally, waits for $50,000
stories.summary: Bitget's CEO says she is not buying into the current bitcoin rally. She says she is waiting for a pullback to $50,000 before adding exposure. The comment stands out against a week of strong gains across crypto markets.
stories.whyItMatters: A prominent exchange executive publicly doubting the rally is a contrarian data point against the bullish mood.
whatToWatch: Whether bitcoin corrects toward the $50,000 level
Other exchange executives' public positioning on the rally
questions: What is the basis for the $50,000 target?
Is this a personal view or a broader Bitget house position?

stories.title: Fed study: bitcoin rallies pull in new buyers driven by belief, not fundamentals
stories.summary: A Federal Reserve experiment finds that bitcoin rallies attract new crypto buyers. The study says crypto investors are largely driven by beliefs and are easily swayed by recent returns rather than by fundamentals.
stories.whyItMatters: The finding suggests current price momentum could be fueling further retail buying, a pattern regulators watch for signs of speculative excess.
whatToWatch: Any follow-up commentary from the Fed on retail crypto behavior
questions: What methodology and sample size did the study use?
Could this buying pattern reverse as quickly as it forms?

sources.title: Fed experiment shows how bitcoin rallies attract new crypto buyers
Fed study finds crypto investors driven by beliefs, easily swayed by returns

stories.title: Solana vote could push daily SOL burns to $800,000, slow new token launches
stories.summary: A new governance vote on Solana could raise daily SOL token burns to about $800,000. The change is also expected to slow the pace of new token creation on the network.
stories.whyItMatters: Changes to token issuance and burn mechanics directly affect SOL's supply dynamics, a key input for its valuation.
whatToWatch: The outcome of the governance vote
Implementation timeline if the vote passes
Impact on new token launch volume on Solana
questions: Who proposed the change, and why?
How will slower token creation affect developer activity on Solana?

stories.title: Strategy builds $1.6B cash pool after $2B share raise, holds off on new BTC buys
stories.summary: Strategy raised $2 billion through a sale of common shares and used it to launch a $1.6 billion cash pool. The company is holding off on new bitcoin purchases for now.
stories.whyItMatters: Strategy is the largest corporate bitcoin holder, so its capital raises and buying pace are watched as signals of institutional demand.
whatToWatch: When Strategy resumes bitcoin purchases
How the new cash pool gets deployed
questions: What is the cash pool meant to fund if not immediate bitcoin buys?

stories.title: Ether outperforms bitcoin as 'golden cross' points to more room to run
stories.summary: Ether has been outperforming bitcoin in recent trading. A technical 'golden cross' pattern in ether's chart suggests, per CoinDesk, that the outperformance may not be finished yet.
stories.whyItMatters: A sustained rotation from bitcoin into ether would mark a shift in market leadership that traders and allocators track closely.
whatToWatch: Whether ether keeps gaining against bitcoin
Confirmation of the golden cross pattern in coming sessions
questions: How reliable has this technical pattern been historically for ether?

stories.title: Ethereum lending app Term Finance loses $8.5M in governance exploit
stories.summary: Ethereum lending app Term Finance lost $8.5 million after an attacker bought up voting power in the protocol and used it to carry out the exploit.
stories.whyItMatters: Governance-based attacks show vote-buying, not just code bugs, remains a real risk for DeFi protocols with token-weighted control.
whatToWatch: Whether Term Finance recovers funds or compensates affected users
Any post-mortem explaining the exploit mechanics
questions: How did the attacker acquire enough voting power to act?
Will other protocols with similar governance models face added scrutiny?

stories.title: Pakistan opens crypto licensing portal with September 5 deadline
stories.summary: Pakistan has opened a licensing portal for crypto firms, starting its formal registration regime. Existing firms operating in the country must register by September 5.
stories.whyItMatters: A national licensing framework signals Pakistan is moving from ambiguity toward formal oversight of crypto businesses.
whatToWatch: Which firms register before the September 5 deadline
Enforcement action against unregistered operators after the deadline
questions: What happens to firms that miss the deadline?
What specific licensing categories or requirements apply?

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs pull in $1.9B in strongest week since October 2025
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs took in $1.9 billion of net inflows over the past week. That is the strongest weekly total since October 2025.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a key gauge of institutional demand and have tracked closely with bitcoin's price moves this year.
whatToWatch: Whether inflows continue at this pace next week
Individual fund flow data for confirmation
questions: Which funds drove most of the inflow?
Is this new capital or a reallocation from other products?

stories.whyItMatters: Strategy's paper gains or losses are a widely watched proxy for how the market's largest corporate bitcoin bet is faring.
